originalManifest.source:
[workspace]

[package]
name = "semio-s-artifact-stdio-tiff-test-oracle"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false
description = "🔮️ Owned independent test oracle provider"

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "test"

[lib]
name = "semio_s_artifact_stdio_tiff_test_oracle"
path = "../../🦀️.rs"

[features]
oracles = ["dep:tiff"]

[dependencies]
"semio-repo-test-host" = { path = "../../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/🧪️test/📦️packages/🦀️rust", default-features = false }
"tiff" = { version = "0.11", optional = true }

[workspace]

[package]
name = "semio-s-artifact-stdio-bmp-test-oracle"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false
description = "🔮️ Owned independent test oracle provider"

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "test"

[lib]
name = "semio_s_artifact_stdio_bmp_test_oracle"
path = "../../🦀️.rs"

[features]
oracles = ["dep:image", "semio-s-plugin-stdio-raster-test-oracle/oracles"]

[dependencies]
"image" = { version = "0.25", optional = true, default-features = false, features = ["bmp", "tiff", "jpeg"] }
"semio-repo-test-host" = { path = "../../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/🧪️test/📦️packages/🦀️rust", default-features = false }
"semio-s-plugin-stdio-raster-test-oracle" = { path = "../../../../../🔮️oracles/🖼️raster/📦️packages/🦀️rust", default-features = false }

[workspace]

[package]
name = "semio-s-artifact-note-note-test-oracle"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
publish = false
description = "🔮️ Owned independent test oracle provider"

[package.metadata.semio]
role = "test"

[lib]
name = "semio_s_artifact_note_note_test_oracle"
path = "../../🦀️.rs"

[features]
oracles = ["dep:dxf", "semio-s-plugin-stdio-document-test-oracle/oracles", "semio-s-plugin-stdio-markup-test-oracle/oracles"]

[dependencies]
"dxf" = { version = "0.6", optional = true }
"semio-repo-test-host" = { path = "../../../../../../../../🧰️framework/🛍️products/🦑️repo/🔨️modules/🧪️test/📦️packages/🦀️rust", default-features = false }
"semio-s-plugin-stdio-document-test-oracle" = { path = "../../../../../../🗄️stdio/🔮️oracles/📃️document/📦️packages/🦀️rust", default-features = false }
"semio-s-plugin-stdio-markup-test-oracle" = { path = "../../../../../../🗄️stdio/🔮️oracles/📰markup/📦️packages/🦀️rust", default-features = false }
